newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land hits high ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land hits high ahead of results.

text.p: Shares of Henderson Land Development Co Ltd rose to a record high in late-morning trade ahead of the release of its full-year earnings on Wednesday, brokers said.

"Expectations of strong company earnings growth fuelled buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. "Its low P.E. (price to earnings ratio) of 14 compared with other property counters such as Sun Hung Kai Properties, which was at about 17, also aided demand."
The shares rose HK$0.75 to hit a new high of HK$62.25 before steadying at HK$62.00 with 1.15 million shares traded.
